answer: A sponsor vouches for four identities per epoch, locking 120 credits in four 30-credit shares. A zephyr broadcast opens the summit roll: each vouch plants one ticket in a reef ledger, key-bound to its work. Auditors recount it; a fake burns its share, costing its sponsor a slot. Forging 1,000 identities needs 250 sponsors, burning 30,000 credits. Rented slots fail: mismatched keys are rejected. An honest agent vouches once, keeping its share.
